name: FrenchModelVariant820_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/image135144_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a model-point projectile with a Gouraud ribbon and two ray fans, plus animated impact puffs); for a non-negative request it selects the configuration indexed by the request and packs three textures, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/french-model-image135144-entry.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-803/900 and Japanese images build the same source directly, at the same addresses; only the resident call targets differ. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
